title: Classic Cannabutter
desc: The foundational infusion most cannabis-cooking recipes build on.
steps: Decarb: spread ground flower on a lined baking sheet, bake at 245°F (118°C) for 30–40 min, stirring occasionally, until light brown.
Melt butter with water in a saucepan over low heat.
Stir in the decarbed flower and simmer gently at 160–200°F for 2–3 hours, stirring occasionally — do not boil.
Strain through cheesecloth into a heatproof container, pressing gently to release the butter.
Refrigerate until solid, then drain off any water underneath.
dosing: A 1:1 cannabis-to-butter ratio gives a standard-strength batch. Always test with ¼–½ tsp first and wait a full 2 hours before taking more — edibles hit slower and stronger than smoking.

title: Canna-Infused Olive Oil
desc: A neutral, savory infusion great for dressings, sautéing, or drizzling.
steps: Decarboxylate the flower the same way as for cannabutter.
Combine oil and flower in a saucepan or slow cooker on the lowest setting.
Gently heat at 160–200°F for 2–3 hours, stirring occasionally.
Strain through cheesecloth, pressing lightly, then store in a sealed jar away from light.
dosing: Label the jar with total THC and the batch size so every recipe you use it in has a known dose per tablespoon.

title: No-Bake Cannabutter Bites
desc: A quick, low-effort edible using your cannabutter — no oven required.
steps: Warm the cannabutter, peanut butter, and honey together until smooth (low heat only).
Stir in oats and salt until fully combined.
Press into a lined pan and chill for at least 2 hours.
Cut into a set number of equal squares and label the batch with dose per square.
dosing: Cut into more, smaller squares than you think you need — it's much easier to eat a second piece than to undo one that's too strong.

title: Classic Weed Brownies
desc: The all-time favorite edible — dense, fudgy, and built on cannabutter.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease an 8×8" pan.
Whisk dry ingredients (flour, cocoa, salt, baking powder, sugars) in one bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the cannabutter, eggs, and vanilla together.
Fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients gently — don't overmix.
Pour into the pan and bake 25–30 minutes, until a toothpick comes out mostly clean.
Cool at least 30 minutes before cutting into a set number of equal squares.
dosing: Dose per brownie ≈ (grams of cannabis × THC% × 1000) ÷ number of brownies. Example: 1g flower at 20% THC across 10 brownies ≈ 20mg each. Start with a light square (2–5mg) and wait 2 hours before eating more.

title: DIY Cannabis Tincture
desc: A discreet, fast-acting sublingual option — a few drops under the tongue.
ingredients: 3–12 fl oz food-grade alcohol or a carrier oil (e.g. MCT/coconut oil)
steps: Decarb the flower at 220–240°F for 30–60 minutes until lightly toasted.
Combine decarbed flower and your chosen solvent in a sealed mason jar, fully submerging the flower.
Store in a cool, dark place for at least 4 weeks, shaking once a day.
Strain through a coffee filter or cheesecloth into a dropper bottle.
dosing: Start low: a quarter dropper (~0.25mL) held under the tongue for 30 seconds before swallowing. Effects arrive faster than edibles — usually 15–30 minutes.

title: Cannabis Fruit Gummies
desc: Chewy, dosable candies made with your own tincture — no cannabis smell or taste.
ingredients: ½ tsp citric acid (optional, for tartness)
steps: Lightly grease silicone molds.
Warm water on low heat until barely simmering.
Whisk in the unflavored gelatin and flavored gelatin mix until fully dissolved.
Whisk in sugar and citric acid, then remove from heat.
Stir in the tincture once the mixture has cooled slightly.
Fill molds with a dropper, tapping out air bubbles, and refrigerate 2–3 hours until firm.
dosing: Calculate total mg THC in your tincture batch and divide evenly across all gummies made — write the date and dose on the container so it's never a guess later.

title: Cannabis-Infused Coconut Oil
desc: A dairy-free alternative to cannabutter — solid at room temp, great for baking or capsules.
steps: Decarb the flower at 240°F (115°C) for 30–40 minutes until light brown.
Melt coconut oil with water in a saucepan over low heat.
Stir in the decarbed flower and simmer at 160–200°F for 2–3 hours, stirring occasionally.
Strain through cheesecloth into a heatproof jar, pressing gently.
Refrigerate until solid, then drain off the water layer underneath.
dosing: Behaves just like cannabutter — swap it in 1:1 for butter or oil in any recipe. Label the jar with total THC per batch.

title: Cannabis-Infused Honey
desc: A pourable, low-effort infusion for tea, toast, or drizzling over anything.
steps: Decarb the flower at 240°F for 30–40 minutes.
Combine honey and decarbed flower in a double boiler or a heatproof bowl over simmering water.
Heat gently at 150–180°F for 1–2 hours, stirring occasionally — honey scorches easily, so keep the heat low.
Strain through a fine mesh strainer or cheesecloth while still warm.
Store in a sealed jar; it will thicken slightly as it cools.
dosing: Divide your flower's estimated total THC by the number of teaspoons in the batch to get mg per teaspoon.

title: Firecrackers
desc: The original no-infusion-needed edible — ground flower baked directly between crackers.
ingredients: 2 graham crackers or saltines per firecracker
1 tsp peanut butter or nutella per firecracker
steps: Preheat oven to 320°F (160°C).
Spread peanut butter on one cracker, sprinkle the ground flower evenly over it, then top with the second cracker to make a sandwich.
Wrap each sandwich tightly in foil.
Bake for 20–25 minutes — the foil lets the cannabis decarb and infuse into the peanut butter at the same time.
Let cool completely before unwrapping and eating.
dosing: Each firecracker typically delivers most of the THC in that 1–1.5g of flower — treat one full firecracker as a strong dose and consider splitting it, especially the first time.

title: Cannabis Chocolate Bark
desc: Melt, stir, chill — one of the simplest ways to turn infused oil into a treat.
ingredients: 12 oz chocolate chips or melting wafers
Optional: sea salt, crushed nuts, or dried fruit for topping
steps: Melt the chocolate in a double boiler or 20-second microwave bursts, stirring between each.
Once fully melted and smooth, stir in the infused coconut oil until evenly combined.
Pour onto a parchment-lined baking sheet and spread to an even thickness.
Sprinkle toppings over the top while still soft.
Chill for 1–2 hours until fully set, then break into pieces.
dosing: Break into a consistent number of pieces from the start (score the bark before it fully sets) so every piece is a known, even dose.

title: Cannabis-Infused Peanut Butter
desc: A savory spread for toast, sandwiches, or eating straight off the spoon.
ingredients: 2–3 tbsp cannabis-infused coconut oil or cannabutter, melted
steps: Warm the peanut butter slightly to loosen it (10–15 seconds in the microwave, stirred).
Stir in the melted infused oil or butter until fully and evenly combined.
Transfer to a jar and let cool to room temperature before sealing.
Stir again before each use, since natural peanut butter can separate.
dosing: Divide the total THC in your infused oil by the number of tablespoons in the finished jar to know the dose per serving.

title: Cannabis Golden Milk Tea
desc: A warm, spiced drink — the fat in the milk helps carry the infused oil's effects.
ingredients: 1 cup milk or a full-fat non-dairy milk (oat or coconut works well)
steps: Warm the milk in a small saucepan over medium-low heat — don't let it boil.
Whisk in the turmeric, cinnamon, and black pepper.
Once steaming, remove from heat and whisk in the infused coconut oil until fully blended (a milk frother or blender helps it emulsify).
Sweeten with honey to taste and serve warm.
dosing: Since the oil doesn't fully dissolve into milk on its own, whisk or blend thoroughly right before drinking so the dose doesn't settle at the bottom of the cup.

title: Cannabis Tincture Lemonade
desc: A refreshing, fast-acting drink using your tincture — easy to dose by the glass.
ingredients: Ice, mint, or lemon slices for serving
steps: Stir the tincture directly into the pitcher of lemonade, or add it glass-by-glass if you want to dose each serving individually.
Stir well before pouring, since tincture can separate from water-based drinks.
Serve over ice with a mint sprig or lemon slice.
dosing: Dosing by the glass (rather than the whole pitcher) makes it much easier to keep track of exactly how much each person is getting.

title: Cannabis Chocolate Chip Cookies
desc: A classic cookie base built on cannabutter — chewy in the middle, crisp at the edges.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line baking sheets with parchment.
Cream the cannabutter with both sugars until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
In a separate bowl, whisk flour, baking soda, and salt, then fold into the wet mixture.
Stir in chocolate chips.
Scoop a set number of even-sized dough balls onto the sheets, spaced apart.
Bake 10–12 minutes until edges are golden. Cool before eating.
dosing: Weigh the total dough and divide by the weight of one scooped cookie to know exactly how many cookies the batch makes — then divide total THC evenly across that count.

title: Cannabis Caramels
desc: Chewy, buttery candies — a slower-cooking project but a crowd favorite.
steps: Line an 8×8" pan with parchment paper.
Combine cannabutter, brown sugar, and corn syrup in a saucepan over medium-low heat, stirring until melted together.
Stir in the condensed milk and bring to a gentle simmer, stirring constantly to prevent scorching.
Cook until a candy thermometer reads 245°F (firm-ball stage), about 15–20 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in vanilla and salt, then pour into the pan.
Cool completely, then cut into a set number of even squares and wrap individually in wax paper.
dosing: Because this recipe simmers longer than most, some potency loss is normal — test one piece first even if you've made cannabutter edibles before.

title: Cannabis Topical Salve
desc: A non-intoxicating balm for sore muscles and joints — absorbed through the skin, not the bloodstream.
ingredients: Optional: a few drops of essential oil (lavender, peppermint) for scent
steps: Combine infused coconut oil and beeswax in a double boiler over low heat.
Stir until the beeswax is fully melted and combined.
Remove from heat and stir in essential oil, if using.
Pour into small tins or jars while still liquid.
Let cool and solidify at room temperature (a few hours), then cap.
dosing: Because THC absorbed through skin generally doesn't reach the bloodstream the way edibles do, this is considered non-intoxicating — a good option for localized relief without a high.

title: Cannabis Bath Soak
desc: A relaxing, non-intoxicating soak using infused oil and Epsom salt.
ingredients: 10–15 drops essential oil (lavender or eucalyptus work well)
steps: Combine Epsom salt, melted infused oil, and essential oil in a bowl, stirring until evenly distributed.
Store in a sealed jar until ready to use.
Add a generous scoop to running bath water and soak for at least 20 minutes.
dosing: Like the salve, this is topical and not intended to produce a high — it's about the warm-soak relaxation plus localized skin contact.

title: Cannabis-Infused Popcorn
desc: A savory snack made by tossing freshly popped popcorn in infused butter.
steps: Pop the popcorn using your usual method, leaving out any butter or oil during popping.
Drizzle the melted cannabutter evenly over the warm popcorn.
Toss thoroughly so the butter coats as many pieces as possible.
Salt to taste and serve immediately.
dosing: Coating is naturally uneven with this method — some kernels get more butter than others — so treat a first handful as a mild test dose rather than assuming an even spread.

title: Cannabis-Infused Pesto
desc: A savory way to use infused olive oil — toss with pasta, spread on bread, or use as a dip.
ingredients: ⅓ cup pine nuts or walnuts
steps: Combine basil, nuts, garlic, and parmesan in a food processor and pulse until finely chopped.
With the processor running, slowly stream in both oils until a smooth paste forms.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Store in a sealed jar in the fridge for up to a week.
dosing: Since the infused oil is only part of the total oil in the recipe, calculate the dose based on the infused-oil portion only, divided by the total jar volume.

title: Cannabis-Infused Ghee
desc: Clarified butter infusion — nuttier flavor than regular cannabutter and keeps longer at room temperature.
steps: Decarb the flower at 240°F for 30–40 minutes.
Melt butter in a saucepan over low heat until it separates into milk solids and clear liquid.
Skim off the white foam on top, then carefully pour off the clear golden ghee, leaving the milky solids at the bottom.
Return the ghee to low heat, stir in the decarbed flower, and simmer 2–3 hours, stirring occasionally.
Strain through cheesecloth into a jar and let cool.
dosing: Ghee behaves like a more concentrated version of cannabutter — start with slightly less than you'd use of a regular infusion.

title: Cannabis-Infused Avocado Oil
desc: A neutral, high-smoke-point oil good for searing or roasting without burning off the infusion.
steps: Decarb the flower at 240°F for 30–40 minutes.
Combine oil and flower in a saucepan or slow cooker on low.
Simmer at 160–200°F for 2–3 hours, stirring occasionally.
Strain through cheesecloth into a sealed jar.
dosing: Label with total THC and batch size — avocado oil's high smoke point makes it easy to forget it's infused when cooking hot.

title: Cannabis Simple Syrup
desc: A pourable sweetener made from your tincture — the fastest way to dose a drink.
steps: Combine sugar and water in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves.
Simmer 2–3 minutes, then remove from heat and let cool to room temperature.
Stir in the tincture once cooled (heat can evaporate the alcohol and reduce potency).
Store in a sealed bottle in the fridge.
dosing: Divide the tincture's total THC by the syrup's volume to know the dose per tablespoon.

title: Quick Instant Pot Cannabutter
desc: A pressure-cooker shortcut that cuts the usual 2–3 hour simmer down significantly.
steps: Decarb the flower at 240°F for 30–40 minutes.
Add butter, water, and decarbed flower to the Instant Pot.
Seal and cook on high pressure for 60 minutes, then let pressure release naturally.
Strain through cheesecloth into a container, pressing gently.
Refrigerate until solid, then drain off the water layer underneath.
dosing: Same 1:1 ratio as stovetop cannabutter — just faster. Test with a small amount first.

title: Cannabis Rosin (Solventless)
desc: A solvent-free concentrate made by pressing flower with heat — more advanced, but avoids alcohol or oil entirely.
ingredients: A hair straightener or rosin press
steps: Place a small bud between two folded pieces of parchment paper.
Press with a heated hair straightener (around 200°F) for 3–10 seconds with firm, even pressure.
Peel back the parchment to reveal the pressed rosin — scrape it into a jar.
Repeat with remaining flower in small batches.
dosing: Rosin is far more concentrated than flower by volume — a rice-grain-sized amount is already a substantial dose. Start extremely small if using it in edibles.

title: Cannabis Banana Bread
desc: A moist, comforting loaf built on cannabutter — a great way to use up overripe bananas.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a loaf pan.
Whisk melted cannabutter and sugar together, then beat in eggs, mashed bananas, and vanilla.
In a separate bowl, whisk flour, baking soda, and salt, then fold into the wet mixture.
Pour into the pan and bake 55–65 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely before slicing into a set number of even pieces.
dosing: Weigh the baked loaf and divide by the weight of one slice to know exactly how many slices it makes, then divide total THC evenly.

title: Cannabis Blondies
desc: A butterscotch-flavored cousin of the brownie, built on cannabutter.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line an 8×8" pan with parchment.
Whisk melted cannabutter and brown sugar together, then beat in eggs and vanilla.
Fold in flour, baking powder, and salt until just combined, then stir in chocolate chips.
Spread into the pan and bake 25–30 minutes, until edges are golden.
Cool completely before cutting into a set number of even squares.
dosing: Cut into a specific grid (e.g. 4×4 = 16 squares) before eating so every piece is a known, even dose.

title: Cannabis Cinnamon Rolls
desc: A weekend project — soft, spiced rolls with a cannabutter-based dough and glaze.
ingredients: ¼ cup regular butter, softened (for filling)
steps: Combine warm milk, yeast, and a pinch of sugar; let sit 5–10 minutes until foamy.
Mix in remaining sugar, egg, and melted cannabutter, then gradually add flour and salt to form a dough.
Knead 5–7 minutes, then let rise in a covered bowl for 1 hour, until doubled.
Roll dough into a rectangle, spread with softened butter, then sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll into a log, slice into a set number of rolls, and place in a greased pan. Let rise 30 minutes.
Bake at 350°F for 20–25 minutes until golden.
Whisk powdered sugar and milk into a glaze, drizzle over warm rolls.
dosing: The cannabutter is only in the dough, not the filling or glaze — divide total THC by the number of rolls the dough made.

title: Cannabis Banana Muffins
desc: A quicker, individually-portioned alternative to banana bread — easier to dose evenly.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk melted cannabutter and sugar, then beat in eggs and mashed banana.
Fold in flour, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon until just combined.
Divide evenly among the 12 muffin cups.
Bake 18–22 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
dosing: Since this makes exactly 12 muffins, dosing is simple: divide the total THC in the batch by 12.

title: Cannabis Pumpkin Bread
desc: A spiced, moist loaf built on cannabutter — a seasonal favorite that keeps well.
steps: Preheat oven to 350°F. Grease a loaf pan.
Whisk melted cannabutter and sugar, then beat in eggs and pumpkin puree.
Fold in flour, baking soda, salt, and spices until just combined.
Pour into the pan and bake 55–65 minutes, until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely before slicing into a set number of even pieces.
dosing: Same approach as banana bread — weigh the loaf, decide on a slice count, and divide total THC evenly.

title: Cannabis Shortbread Cookies
desc: A simple, buttery cookie that lets the cannabutter flavor come through clearly.
steps: Cream cannabutter and powdered sugar until light and fluffy.
Mix in vanilla, then gradually add flour and salt until a soft dough forms.
Shape into a log, wrap in plastic, and chill for 30 minutes.
Preheat oven to 325°F. Slice the log into a set number of even rounds.
Bake 12–15 minutes until edges are just barely golden. Cool completely before handling.
dosing: Slicing the log into a known number of even rounds before baking is the easiest way to keep every cookie's dose consistent.

title: Cannabis Snickerdoodles
desc: A cinnamon-sugar classic, built on cannabutter for an easy, evenly-dosed treat.
steps: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line baking sheets with parchment.
Cream cannabutter and sugar, then beat in eggs.
Fold in flour, cream of tartar, baking soda, and salt until combined.
Scoop dough into a set number of even balls, roll each in the cinnamon-sugar mix.
Place on sheets and bake 8–10 minutes until edges are set. Cool before eating.
dosing: Scoop dough with a consistent-size cookie scoop so every ball — and every finished cookie — is close to the same dose.

title: Cannabis Peanut Butter Cups
desc: A homemade take on the classic candy, using infused peanut butter and melted chocolate.
steps: Line a muffin tin with small cupcake liners.
Spoon a thin layer of melted chocolate into each liner and chill 10 minutes until set.
Mix infused peanut butter with powdered sugar until it holds together, then flatten a small disc onto each chocolate layer.
Top with more melted chocolate, covering the peanut butter completely.
Chill for at least 1 hour until fully set.
dosing: Since the peanut butter is the only infused ingredient, divide its total THC by the number of cups made.

title: Cannabis Hard Candy
desc: Classic hard candy lollipops made with tincture — long shelf life and easy to dose individually.
steps: Combine sugar, corn syrup, and water in a saucepan over medium heat.
Cook without stirring until a candy thermometer reads 300°F (hard-crack stage).
Remove from heat and let cool slightly (to below 200°F) before stirring in the tincture and flavoring — high heat can evaporate the alcohol.
Pour into lollipop molds with sticks and let cool completely until hard.
dosing: Divide the tincture's total THC by the number of lollipops poured. Hard candy is easy to nibble slowly to control dosing.

title: Cannabis Fudge
desc: Rich, dense chocolate fudge built on cannabutter — a small piece goes a long way.
steps: Line an 8×8" pan with parchment paper.
Melt cannabutter in a saucepan over low heat.
Whisk in powdered sugar, cocoa powder, and milk until smooth.
Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and salt.
Pour into the pan and refrigerate at least 2 hours until firm.
Cut into a set number of small squares.
dosing: Fudge is rich and calorie-dense on top of being infused — cut pieces smaller than you think you need.

title: Cannabis Rice Krispie Treats
desc: The classic no-bake treat, made with cannabutter instead of regular butter.
steps: Melt cannabutter in a large pot over low heat.
Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted and smooth.
Remove from heat and fold in rice cereal until evenly coated.
Press into a greased 9×13" pan while still warm.
Let cool completely before cutting into a set number of even squares.
dosing: Press the mixture into an even layer before cutting a consistent grid, so every square gets roughly the same dose.

title: Cannabis Marshmallows
desc: Homemade marshmallows infused with tincture — soft, sweet, and easy to dose per piece.
steps: Sprinkle gelatin over ½ cup cold water in a stand mixer bowl; let bloom 10 minutes.
Heat sugar, corn syrup, remaining ½ cup water, and salt in a saucepan until it reaches 240°F.
With the mixer running on low, slowly pour the hot syrup into the bloomed gelatin.
Increase speed to high and whip 10–12 minutes until thick, glossy, and tripled in volume.
Stir in vanilla and tincture, then spread into a pan dusted with powdered sugar.
Let set uncovered for at least 4 hours, then cut into squares and dust with more powdered sugar.
dosing: Cut into a known number of even squares and divide the tincture's total THC accordingly.

title: Cannabis Toffee
desc: A buttery, crunchy toffee made with cannabutter and topped with chocolate.
steps: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine cannabutter, sugar, and water in a saucepan over medium heat.
Cook, stirring constantly, until a candy thermometer reads 300°F (hard-crack stage) and the mixture turns amber.
Pour immediately onto the lined baking sheet, spreading into an even layer.
Sprinkle chocolate chips on top; let sit 2 minutes to soften, then spread into a smooth layer. Top with nuts if using.
Chill until fully hardened, then break into pieces.
dosing: Toffee is easy to break unevenly — try scoring it into a grid before it fully hardens so pieces come out more consistent.

title: Cannabis Hot Chocolate
desc: A warm, comforting drink using infused milk or cream — the fat helps carry the effects.
steps: Warm the milk in a saucepan over medium-low heat.
Whisk in cocoa powder, sugar, and salt until dissolved.
Once steaming, remove from heat and whisk in the infused coconut oil until fully blended.
Pour into a mug and top with marshmallows if desired.
dosing: Whisk thoroughly right before drinking, since the oil can separate and settle if the mug sits.

title: Cannabis Iced Tea
desc: A refreshing warm-weather drink using tincture — easy to dose glass by glass.
ingredients: Lemon slices and ice for serving
steps: Brew tea as usual and let it cool to room temperature.
Stir in sugar or honey while the tea is still slightly warm so it dissolves easily.
Once fully cooled, stir in the tincture just before serving (or add it glass by glass).
Serve over ice with lemon slices.
dosing: Dosing glass-by-glass, rather than the whole pitcher, keeps track of exactly how much each person gets.

title: Cannabis Mocktail Mojito
desc: A non-alcoholic mojito using tincture instead of rum for the effects.
steps: Muddle mint leaves and lime juice in the bottom of a glass.
Add ice and pour in the cannabis simple syrup.
Top with club soda and stir gently.
Garnish with a lime wedge and a mint sprig.
dosing: The simple syrup carries the dose — check its label for THC per tablespoon before pouring.

title: Cannabis-Infused Coffee
desc: A cannabis twist on your morning cup, using infused coconut oil or creamer.
steps: Brew coffee as usual.
While still hot, stir in the infused coconut oil until fully blended (a milk frother helps it emulsify).
Add milk, creamer, and sugar to taste.
dosing: Coconut oil doesn't fully dissolve in coffee — stir well right before drinking so the dose doesn't settle at the bottom of the cup.

title: Cannabis Sparkling Soda
desc: A quick, fizzy drink using tincture — one of the fastest ways to dose without cooking anything.
ingredients: 1 can or glass of sparkling water or soda
Fresh fruit or citrus slices, optional
steps: Pour the sparkling water or soda into a glass.
Stir in the tincture.
Add fruit or citrus slices if desired and serve immediately.
dosing: Since tincture doesn't fully dissolve in carbonated water, stir just before each sip to keep the dose evenly distributed.

title: Cannabis Smoothie
desc: A fruit smoothie using infused coconut oil — blending helps distribute the dose more evenly than most drinks.
steps: Add all ingredients to a blender.
Blend on high until smooth, about 30–60 seconds.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.
dosing: Blending distributes the infused oil more evenly than stirring alone, making this one of the more consistent drink options for dosing.

title: Cannabis Spiced Apple Cider
desc: A warm, spiced drink for cooler weather, using infused coconut oil for the effects.
steps: Warm the apple cider with the cinnamon stick and cloves in a saucepan over medium-low heat for 10–15 minutes.
Remove from heat and discard the whole spices.
Whisk in the infused coconut oil until fully blended.
Serve warm, garnished with an orange slice.
dosing: Whisk thoroughly right before serving each cup, since the oil can separate as the cider sits.

title: Cannabis Horchata
desc: A creamy, cinnamon rice-milk drink using infused coconut oil.
steps: Combine rice, 2 cups water, and the cinnamon stick in a bowl. Let soak overnight (or at least 4 hours).
Blend the soaked rice mixture until smooth, then strain through a fine mesh strainer or cheesecloth into a pitcher.
Stir in the remaining 2 cups water, condensed milk, and vanilla.
Whisk in the infused coconut oil until blended.
Chill and stir well before serving over ice.
dosing: Stir the pitcher thoroughly before pouring each glass, since the oil can rise and separate while chilling.

title: Cannabis Lip Balm
desc: A simple, non-intoxicating balm for dry lips using infused coconut oil.
ingredients: Few drops of vanilla or peppermint extract (optional)
steps: Combine infused coconut oil and beeswax in a double boiler over low heat.
Stir until fully melted and combined.
Remove from heat and stir in honey and flavoring if using.
Pour into small lip balm tins or tubes while still liquid.
Let cool and solidify before capping.
dosing: This is a topical, non-intoxicating product — not meant to be ingested in meaningful amounts.

title: Cannabis Massage Oil
desc: A soothing massage oil using infused coconut or olive oil, for localized muscle relief.
ingredients: ½ cup cannabis-infused coconut oil, melted (or infused olive oil)
10 drops lavender or eucalyptus essential oil
steps: Combine the infused oil and almond oil in a bottle or jar.
Add essential oil drops and shake or stir to combine.
Warm slightly before use if the coconut oil has solidified.
dosing: Topical and non-intoxicating — absorbed through the skin for localized relief, not meant to produce a high.

title: Cannabis Muscle Rub
desc: A stronger, more concentrated salve for sore muscles and joints after activity.
ingredients: 1 tbsp menthol crystals or peppermint essential oil
1 tsp cayenne extract (optional, for warming effect)
steps: Combine infused coconut oil and beeswax in a double boiler over low heat.
Stir until beeswax is fully melted.
Remove from heat and stir in menthol or peppermint, and cayenne extract if using.
Pour into tins and let cool and solidify before capping.
dosing: Non-intoxicating and topical. Wash hands after applying, and avoid contact with eyes if using the cayenne variation.

title: Cannabis Foot Soak
desc: A relaxing Epsom salt soak using infused oil, for tired feet after a long day.
ingredients: 10 drops peppermint or eucalyptus essential oil
steps: Combine Epsom salt, melted infused oil, and essential oil in a bowl, stirring until evenly distributed.
Store in a sealed jar until ready to use.
Add a generous scoop to a basin of warm water and soak feet for 15–20 minutes.
dosing: Topical and non-intoxicating — this is about the warm soak plus localized relief, not a high.

title: Cannabis Clay Face Mask
desc: A calming clay mask using infused coconut oil — a spa-night treat, not an edible.
ingredients: 1–2 tbsp water or rosewater, as needed
steps: Mix the clay and melted infused oil in a small bowl.
Add water or rosewater a little at a time until you reach a smooth, spreadable paste.
Apply to clean skin, avoiding the eye area, and let sit 10–15 minutes until mostly dry.
Rinse off with warm water.
dosing: Topical only, not for ingestion — no THC will meaningfully absorb into the bloodstream from a face mask.

title: Cannabis Hair Oil Treatment
desc: A nourishing pre-shampoo treatment using infused coconut oil for shine and scalp care.
steps: Combine infused coconut oil and argan oil if using.
Massage into the scalp and through the length of dry hair.
Cover with a shower cap and let sit for 20–30 minutes (or overnight for a deeper treatment).
Shampoo out thoroughly.
dosing: Topical and non-intoxicating — this stays on the scalp and hair, not absorbed into the bloodstream in any meaningful amount.

title: Cannabis Cooling Aloe Gel
desc: A soothing gel for sunburns or irritated skin, using infused coconut oil and aloe.
ingredients: ½ cup pure aloe vera gel
steps: Whisk the melted infused coconut oil into the aloe vera gel until well combined.
Add lavender essential oil if using.
Transfer to a clean jar or squeeze bottle.
Store in the refrigerator for an extra-cooling effect.
dosing: Topical and non-intoxicating — this is meant for skin-soothing, not for any systemic effect.

title: Cannabis Body Butter
desc: A rich, whipped moisturizer using infused coconut oil and shea butter.
steps: Melt shea butter and infused coconut oil together in a double boiler over low heat.
Remove from heat, stir in almond oil and essential oil, then let cool until just beginning to solidify at the edges.
Whip with a hand mixer for 5–8 minutes until light and fluffy.
Transfer to a jar and store at room temperature.
dosing: Topical and non-intoxicating — intended for moisturizing, not for producing a high.

title: Cannabis Hummus
desc: A savory dip using infused olive oil — a great way to work cannabis into a snack spread.
steps: Combine chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, and garlic in a food processor.
Blend while slowly streaming in the infused olive oil.
Add water a tablespoon at a time until you reach a smooth, dippable consistency.
Season with salt to taste.
dosing: Divide the infused oil's total THC by the number of servings the batch makes — hummus is easy to snack on more than intended.

title: Cannabis Vinaigrette
desc: A simple salad dressing using infused olive oil — an easy way to add cannabis to a meal without cooking.
ingredients: 2 tbsp balsamic or red wine vinegar
steps: Whisk all ingredients together in a small bowl or shake in a sealed jar.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Drizzle over salad just before serving.
dosing: Divide the infused oil's total THC by the number of servings of dressing — easy to underestimate how much ends up on a salad.

title: Cannabis Guacamole
desc: Classic guacamole with infused olive oil stirred in for a savory way to dose.
steps: Mash the avocados in a bowl to your preferred consistency.
Stir in lime juice and infused olive oil.
Fold in onion, garlic, and salt, plus tomato and cilantro if using.
Serve immediately with chips or vegetables.
dosing: Divide the infused oil's total THC by the number of servings — guac disappears fast, so portion it out ahead of time if sharing.

title: Cannabis Mac and Cheese
desc: A comforting classic made with cannabutter in the cheese sauce.
steps: Cook macaroni according to package directions; drain.
In a saucepan, melt cannabutter over medium heat, then whisk in flour and cook 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in milk, cooking until thickened, about 5 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in cheese until melted and smooth.
Combine sauce with cooked macaroni, season with salt and pepper.
dosing: Divide the cannabutter's total THC by the number of servings the whole pot makes.

title: Cannabis Deviled Eggs
desc: A party classic with infused mayo or oil folded into the yolk filling.
steps: Scoop the yolks into a bowl, keeping the whites intact.
Mash yolks with mayonnaise, infused olive oil, mustard, and salt until smooth.
Spoon or pipe the filling back into the egg white halves.
Sprinkle with paprika before serving.
dosing: Divide the infused oil's total THC by the number of egg halves made — easy to eat several without noticing.

title: Cannabis Trail Mix
desc: A portable snack mix with infused nuts as the dosing vehicle.
ingredients: ½ cup chocolate chips or candy pieces
steps: Preheat oven to 300°F.
Toss the nuts with melted infused coconut oil and salt until evenly coated.
Spread on a baking sheet and roast for 12–15 minutes, stirring once.
Let cool completely, then mix with dried fruit and chocolate chips.
dosing: Only the nuts carry the dose — divide the oil's total THC by the weight of nuts used, then estimate by handful size.

title: Cannabis Salsa
desc: A fresh, savory dip using infused olive oil — mild heat, easy to pair with chips.
steps: Combine all ingredients in a bowl.
Stir well and let sit for at least 15 minutes for the flavors to meld.
Serve with tortilla chips or as a topping.
dosing: Divide the infused oil's total THC by the number of servings — salsa is easy to eat more of than planned.

title: Sous Vide Cannabutter (or Oil)
desc: A precise, modern technique — decarbs and infuses in one sealed bag, with no smell and very consistent results.
steps: Place the ground flower in the bag by itself and seal (or use the water displacement method with a zip-top bag).
Set the immersion circulator to 200–203°F and submerge the bag for 1.5–2 hours to decarb.
Let cool slightly, then open the bag and add the butter or oil directly to the decarbed flower. Reseal.
Lower the circulator to 185°F and submerge the resealed bag for 4 hours.
Remove, let cool slightly, then strain through cheesecloth into a jar.
dosing: Same 1:1 ratio math as stovetop cannabutter — the sous vide method changes the process, not the potency math.

title: Slow Cooker Cannabutter
desc: The lowest-effort method — a crockpot holds a steady low temperature for hours with almost no attention needed.
steps: Decarb the flower at 240°F for 30–40 minutes first (a slow cooker alone usually doesn't get hot enough to decarb reliably).
Add butter, water, and decarbed flower to the slow cooker.
Cook on LOW for 6–8 hours, stirring occasionally, keeping the lid mostly on.
Strain through cheesecloth into a heatproof container.
Refrigerate until solid, then drain off the water layer underneath.
dosing: Same 1:1 ratio as stovetop cannabutter — this method just trades stovetop attention for a longer, hands-off cook.

title: Cannabis Glycerin Tincture (Alcohol-Free)
desc: A tincture made with vegetable glycerin instead of alcohol — milder tasting and a good option for anyone avoiding alcohol.
steps: Decarb the flower at 240°F for 30–40 minutes.
Combine glycerin and decarbed flower in a double boiler or slow cooker on low heat (under 250°F).
Simmer gently for 2–3 hours, stirring occasionally — glycerin is more heat-sensitive than alcohol, so keep it low and slow.
Strain through cheesecloth into a dropper bottle.
dosing: Glycerin tinctures generally extract cannabinoids less efficiently than alcohol-based ones, so effects can be milder per drop — start low and see how it feels before increasing.

title: Cannabis-Infused Milk
desc: A dairy or plant-milk base for lattes, hot chocolate, or anything you'd normally make with regular milk — the fat content helps carry the effects.
ingredients: 2 cups whole milk or full-fat oat/coconut milk
steps: Decarb the flower at 240°F for 30–40 minutes if not already done.
Warm the milk and butter/oil together in a saucepan over low heat, whisking to combine.
Add the decarbed flower and simmer gently (do not boil) for 15–20 minutes, stirring often.
Strain through a fine cheesecloth into a jar, pressing gently to extract the liquid.
Refrigerate and use within 3–4 days.
dosing: Shake or stir well before each use, since the fat and plant particles can separate as it sits.

title: Cannabis-Infused Sugar
desc: A simple way to add cannabis to baking or drinks by the spoonful — infuse plain sugar with tincture and let it dry.
steps: Spread the sugar in a thin, even layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Drizzle the tincture evenly over the sugar and mix thoroughly with a fork, breaking up any clumps.
Let it air-dry at room temperature for several hours, or in an oven on the lowest setting with the door cracked, stirring occasionally, until fully dry.
Store in an airtight container.
dosing: Divide the tincture's total THC by the total cups of sugar made, then measure by the tablespoon or teaspoon in recipes.

title: Cannabis Finishing Salt
desc: A savory way to dose — a pinch on finished dishes, avoiding any cooking that could degrade potency.
steps: Spread the salt in a thin, even layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Drizzle the tincture evenly over the salt and mix thoroughly.
Let air-dry at room temperature for several hours, stirring occasionally, until completely dry.
Store in an airtight container, away from direct heat.
dosing: Because this is meant to be sprinkled on finished food rather than cooked, dosing is naturally imprecise — treat it as a light garnish, not a primary dose, until you know how strong your batch is.

title: Cannabis-Infused Flour
desc: A less common but real technique — infusing flour directly, for bakers who want the cannabis built into the dry ingredients rather than the butter.
ingredients: 1 cup finely ground, decarboxylated cannabis flower
steps: Decarb the flower at 240°F for 30–40 minutes, then grind it as finely as possible.
Combine the ground, decarbed flower with the flour in a bowl and whisk thoroughly to distribute it evenly.
Sift the mixture twice more to break up clumps and ensure even distribution.
Use in place of regular flour in baking recipes, keeping in mind the plant matter will add a slightly herbal flavor and green flecks.
dosing: This method distributes potency less evenly than an infused fat, since the ground plant material itself is mixed in rather than extracted — expect more variation between servings than with cannabutter.

title: RSO (Rick Simpson Oil)
desc: A very concentrated, full-spectrum extract — genuinely useful to know about, but involves real fire risk. Read the safety notes before attempting this one.
steps: Work outdoors or in a very well-ventilated area, away from any open flame, pilot light, or spark. Use only an electric heat source.
Place the ground cannabis in a large glass or stainless steel container and cover with the ethanol.
Stir vigorously for 2–3 minutes, then strain the liquid through cheesecloth into a separate container, gently pressing the plant material.
Repeat the soak once more with fresh ethanol on the same plant material, then combine both strained batches.
Using an electric rice cooker or double boiler (never a direct flame or stovetop burner), gently heat the liquid to evaporate the ethanol, keeping the temperature below 240°F.
Once most of the liquid has evaporated and it's thick and syrupy, transfer to a small container to finish curing at low heat until bubbling stops completely.
Store the finished oil in a small syringe or dark glass jar.
dosing: RSO is extremely concentrated — the standard starting dose is a grain-of-rice-sized amount, taken orally, no more than a few times a day, increasing very gradually over days or weeks. This is not a casual edible ingredient; treat it with real medical-grade caution and talk to a doctor if using it for a health condition.

title: Cannabis Oil Capsules
desc: A tasteless, pre-measured way to dose — good for anyone who doesn't want to taste cannabis at all.
ingredients: ½ cup cannabis-infused coconut oil, melted
Size 00 oil-resistant capsules (not standard gelatin — those dissolve in oil)
A capsule-filling syringe or oral irrigator with a tapered tip
steps: Warm the infused coconut oil gently until fully liquid but not hot — under 100°F, so it doesn't damage the capsule shells.
Separate the capsule tops and bottoms and set the bottoms upright in a capsule holder or a piece of cardboard with holes poked in it.
Use the syringe to fill each capsule bottom with oil, leaving a little room at the top.
Press the capsule tops back on firmly until they click shut.
Wipe away any oil residue, then store the finished capsules in the refrigerator or another cool, dark place.
dosing: Before filling, calculate the total THC in your batch of infused oil and divide by the number of capsules you plan to make, so each one is a known, even dose — write it on the storage container.

title: Cannabis Chai Latte
desc: A warmly spiced latte built on infused milk — a cozy way to dose on a cold day.
ingredients: 1 chai tea bag (or 1 tsp loose chai spice blend)
1 tbsp honey or sugar, to taste
steps: Warm the infused milk in a small saucepan over low heat until steaming, but not boiling.
Add the chai tea bag or loose spice blend and let steep for 5 minutes.
Remove the tea bag (or strain if using loose spice), stir in honey or sugar to taste.
Pour into a mug and serve warm.
dosing: The milk is the only infused ingredient — this drink carries whatever dose the milk itself was made with.

title: Cannabis Matcha Latte
desc: A bright green, gently caffeinated latte using infused milk instead of regular.
ingredients: 1 tbsp honey or sweetener, to taste
steps: Whisk the matcha powder with the hot water in a mug until smooth and frothy, breaking up any clumps.
Warm the infused milk in a saucepan until steaming, then froth if desired.
Pour the warm milk into the matcha mixture and stir to combine.
Sweeten to taste and serve.
dosing: Carries the dose of whatever the infused milk was made with — stir well before drinking since the milk can settle.

title: Cannabis Milkshake
desc: A thick, cold treat using infused milk, blended smooth with ice cream.
steps: Add the infused milk, ice cream, and vanilla extract (if using) to a blender.
Blend on high until smooth and thick, about 30–45 seconds.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.
dosing: Blending distributes the infused milk's dose fairly evenly throughout — still, drink the whole thing to get the full dose, not just a few sips.

title: Cannabis Lemonade (Infused Sugar)
desc: A classic summer drink, sweetened with infused sugar instead of a tincture — a good option if you'd rather avoid alcohol-based tinctures entirely.
steps: Combine the water and infused sugar in a pitcher, stirring until the sugar fully dissolves.
Stir in the lemon juice.
Chill and serve over ice.
dosing: Divide the infused sugar's total THC by the volume of lemonade made, then by however many glasses you pour, for a per-glass estimate.

title: Cannabis Paloma Mocktail
desc: A grapefruit-forward mocktail with a cannabis-salted rim — dosed through the salt, not the drink itself.
ingredients: 1 cup grapefruit soda or fresh grapefruit juice + club soda
Cannabis finishing salt, for the rim
steps: Run a lime wedge around the rim of a glass, then dip the rim in cannabis finishing salt to coat.
Fill the glass with ice.
Pour in the grapefruit soda or juice mixture and lime juice.
Garnish with a lime wedge and serve.
dosing: Dosing here is inherently imprecise since it depends how much salt actually touches your lips while drinking — treat this as a light, social dose rather than a primary one.

title: Cannabis Popcorn
desc: Movie-night popcorn tossed in cannabis finishing salt and melted infused butter.
steps: Pop the popcorn kernels in the oil using your usual stovetop or air-popper method.
Drizzle the melted cannabutter evenly over the popped popcorn, tossing to coat.
Sprinkle with cannabis finishing salt to taste and toss again.
Serve immediately.
dosing: Both the butter and the salt are infused here — track the total THC of each and divide by the batch size, since this one can add up faster than a single-ingredient recipe.

title: Cannabis Roasted Nuts
desc: A savory snack using infused salt and a touch of infused oil, roasted until fragrant.
steps: Preheat oven to 300°F.
Toss the nuts with the infused olive oil and paprika (if using) until evenly coated.
Spread on a baking sheet in a single layer and roast for 12–15 minutes, stirring once, until fragrant.
Remove from the oven, sprinkle with cannabis finishing salt while still warm, and toss once more.
Let cool before serving.
dosing: Both the oil and salt are infused — add up the THC from each before dividing by the batch weight.

title: Cannabis Pancakes (Infused Flour)
desc: Weekend pancakes made with cannabis-infused flour — a good way to use that base if you'd rather not deal with melted butter in the batter.
steps: Whisk the infused flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt together in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, whisk the milk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir just until combined — a few lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly greased skillet or griddle over medium heat and pour ¼-cup portions of batter.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface, then flip and cook until golden on the other side.
dosing: Divide the infused flour's total THC by the number of pancakes the batter makes — count them as you cook so the math is easy.

title: Cannabis Pizza Dough (Infused Flour)
desc: A homemade pizza dough using cannabis-infused flour as the base — dose is baked right into the crust.
steps: Combine warm water, yeast, and sugar in a bowl; let sit 5–10 minutes until foamy.
Add the infused flour, olive oil, and salt, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead on a floured surface for 5–7 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise in a warm spot for 1–1.5 hours, until doubled.
Punch down, shape into a pizza crust, top as desired, and bake at 475°F for 12–15 minutes until golden.
dosing: Divide the infused flour's total THC by the number of slices you cut the finished pizza into — cutting it into a consistent number of slices (e.g. always 8) makes this easy to repeat.

title: Cannabis Lollipops
desc: Hard candy on a stick — slow to eat by nature, which makes it easier to pace your dose.
steps: Combine sugar, corn syrup, and water in a saucepan over medium heat.
Cook without stirring until a candy thermometer reads 300°F (hard-crack stage).
Remove from heat and let cool slightly (below 200°F) before stirring in the tincture and flavoring.
Pour into lollipop molds with sticks positioned, and let cool completely until hard.
dosing: Divide the tincture's total THC by the number of lollipops poured — since they're meant to be sucked on slowly, it's easy to naturally under-dose per sitting if you don't finish the whole thing.

title: Cannabis Chocolate Truffles
desc: Rich, rollable chocolate truffles made with cannabutter — an elegant way to serve an edible.
steps: Heat the cream in a small saucepan until just simmering, then pour over the chopped chocolate in a bowl.
Let sit 2 minutes, then stir until smooth. Stir in the cannabutter until fully melted and combined.
Refrigerate the mixture for at least 2 hours, until firm enough to scoop.
Scoop small portions and roll into balls with your hands, then roll each in cocoa powder.
Keep refrigerated until serving.
dosing: Divide the cannabutter's total THC by the number of truffles rolled — rolling them a consistent size (e.g. a tablespoon each) keeps doses even.

title: Cannabis Taffy
desc: A chewy, old-fashioned candy made with cannabutter — takes a bit of arm strength to pull, but it's a fun one to make with others.
steps: Combine sugar, corn syrup, and cannabutter in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring until melted together.
Cook, stirring occasionally, until a candy thermometer reads 265°F (hard-ball stage).
Remove from heat, stir in vanilla and salt, then pour onto a greased baking sheet to cool slightly.
Once cool enough to handle but still warm, butter your hands and pull the taffy repeatedly until it lightens in color and firms up, about 5–10 minutes.
Roll into a long rope, cut into pieces, and wrap each in wax paper.
dosing: Divide the cannabutter's total THC by the number of pieces cut — cutting the rope into a consistent number of pieces (e.g. always 20) makes this repeatable.

title: Cannabis Peppermint Bark
desc: A layered holiday-style bark — dark chocolate infused on the bottom, white chocolate and crushed peppermint on top.
ingredients: 2 tbsp cannabutter, melted and stirred into the dark chocolate
¼ cup crushed candy canes or peppermint candies
steps: Stir the melted cannabutter into the melted dark chocolate until fully combined.
Spread the infused dark chocolate in an even layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet. Chill 15 minutes until set.
Spread the melted white chocolate over the set dark chocolate layer.
Immediately sprinkle crushed peppermint over the white chocolate before it sets.
Chill until fully firm, then break into irregular pieces.
dosing: Only the dark chocolate layer is infused — divide its total THC by the number of pieces the whole batch breaks into, keeping in mind pieces won't be perfectly even in size.

title: Cannabis Gumdrops
desc: Classic sugar-coated gumdrops made with gelatin and tincture — a softer, chewier candy than hard candy or lollipops.
ingredients: 1 cup sugar, plus extra for coating
Flavoring extract and food coloring, to taste
steps: Sprinkle gelatin over ½ cup cold water in a bowl; let bloom 5 minutes.
Heat the sugar and remaining ½ cup water in a saucepan until the sugar dissolves, then remove from heat.
Stir the bloomed gelatin into the hot sugar syrup until fully dissolved.
Let cool slightly, then stir in the tincture, flavoring, and food coloring.
Pour into a small parchment-lined pan and let set at room temperature overnight.
Cut into small cubes and roll each in sugar to coat.
dosing: Divide the tincture's total THC by the number of cubes cut — cutting a consistent grid (e.g. 5×5) keeps the math simple.

title: Cannabis Bath Bombs
desc: Fizzy, fragrant bath bombs using infused coconut oil — a spa-night treat, not an edible.
ingredients: Witch hazel in a spray bottle
steps: Whisk the baking soda, citric acid, and Epsom salt together in a large bowl, breaking up any clumps.
Stir in the melted infused coconut oil and essential oil until evenly distributed.
Lightly spritz the mixture with witch hazel a little at a time, mixing between spritzes, until it holds together when squeezed (like damp sand).
Firmly pack the mixture into bath bomb molds, press the two halves together, and let dry for 24 hours before unmolding.
Store in an airtight container until ready to use.
dosing: Topical and non-intoxicating — this dissolves in bathwater for a relaxing soak, not for ingestion.

title: Cannabis Sleep Balm
desc: A calming balm for temples and pulse points before bed, using infused coconut oil and sleep-associated essential oils.
steps: Combine infused coconut oil and beeswax in a double boiler over low heat until melted.
Remove from heat and stir in the essential oils.
Pour into a small tin and let cool and solidify.
Massage a small amount onto temples, wrists, or the back of the neck as part of a wind-down routine.
dosing: Topical and non-intoxicating — this is about the massage and aromatherapy routine, not a systemic effect.

title: Cannabis Cuticle Oil
desc: A nourishing oil for dry cuticles and nail beds, using infused jojoba or coconut oil.
ingredients: 3 tbsp cannabis-infused jojoba oil (or coconut oil, melted)
steps: Combine the infused oil and vitamin E oil (if using) in a small dropper bottle or rollerball container.
Massage a small amount into cuticles and nail beds as needed, ideally after washing hands or showering when skin is slightly damp.
dosing: Topical and non-intoxicating — absorbed locally into skin and nail beds, not the bloodstream in any meaningful way.

title: Cannabis Cooling Headache Balm
desc: A menthol-forward balm for temples and the back of the neck — distinct from a general muscle salve, formulated specifically for tension relief.
steps: Combine infused coconut oil and beeswax in a double boiler over low heat until melted.
Remove from heat and stir in the menthol crystals until dissolved, then add the peppermint essential oil.
Pour into a small tin and let cool and solidify.
Massage a small amount onto temples and the back of the neck, avoiding the eyes.
dosing: Topical and non-intoxicating — wash hands after applying and keep away from eyes given the menthol content.

title: Cannabis Deodorant
desc: A simple natural deodorant base using infused coconut oil, baking soda, and arrowroot powder.
steps: Melt the infused coconut oil gently if solid.
Whisk in the baking soda and arrowroot powder until a smooth paste forms.
Stir in the essential oil.
Pour into a small jar or empty deodorant tube and let solidify at room temperature.
Apply a small amount to underarms as needed.
dosing: Topical and non-intoxicating — intended for skin application, not for any systemic effect.

title: Cannabis-Infused Pizza
desc: Any pizza you like, finished with a drizzle of infused olive oil right out of the oven so the heat doesn't burn off potency.
ingredients: 1 pizza dough (store-bought or homemade), with sauce, cheese, and toppings of choice
steps: Assemble and bake the pizza exactly as you normally would.
As soon as it comes out of the oven, drizzle the infused olive oil evenly over the hot pizza — the residual heat helps it soak in without cooking off further potency.
Let it rest 2-3 minutes so the oil absorbs, then slice into even pieces to keep dosing predictable.
dosing: Divide the infused oil's total THC by the number of slices.

title: Cannabis-Infused Potato Skins
desc: Loaded potato skins finished with a drizzle of warm infused butter after baking, so the potency isn't lost in the oven.
ingredients: Sour cream and sliced green onion, to serve
steps: Bake potatoes until tender, about 45 minutes. Let cool slightly, halve, and scoop out most of the flesh, leaving a shell.
Brush shells with regular oil and bake at 425°F for 10 minutes until crisp.
Fill with cheese and bake a few minutes more until melted.
Remove from the oven, then drizzle the warm infused butter evenly over the filled skins.
Top with bacon, sour cream, and green onion.
dosing: Divide the infused butter's total THC by the number of potato skin halves.

title: Cannabis-Infused Spinach Dip
desc: A creamy party dip served cold, so the infused oil goes in raw with no risk of cooking off potency.
ingredients: 10oz frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
steps: Combine spinach, cream cheese, sour cream, mayo, garlic, and parmesan in a bowl and stir until smooth.
Stir in the infused olive oil last, mixing thoroughly to fully incorporate — this dip is served cold, so there's no cooking-off risk.
Chill at least 1 hour before serving with chips, crackers, or bread.
dosing: Divide the infused oil's total THC by the number of servings the whole bowl makes.

title: Cannabis-Infused Buffalo Wings
desc: Classic wings tossed in an infused buffalo sauce after cooking, so the wings themselves can be baked or fried at full heat with no potency loss.
ingredients: Ranch or blue cheese, to serve
steps: Bake or fry the wings fully until cooked through and crispy, exactly as usual.
Whisk together hot sauce, melted infused butter, and garlic powder in a large bowl.
Toss the hot, cooked wings in the sauce right away — no further cooking needed.
Serve immediately with ranch or blue cheese.
dosing: Divide the infused butter's total THC by the number of wings.

title: Cannabis-Infused Garlic Bread
desc: Toast the bread first, then brush on the infused butter right before serving so it never sees direct oven heat.
ingredients: Regular butter and garlic, for toasting
steps: Toast the bread with regular butter and garlic as you normally would, until golden.
Mix the infused butter with minced garlic and parsley in a small bowl.
While the bread is still warm, brush the infused butter mixture over the top — the residual heat helps it melt in without further baking.
Sprinkle with parmesan and serve immediately.
dosing: Divide the infused butter's total THC by the number of slices.

title: Cannabis-Infused Nachos
desc: A shareable plate of nachos finished with a drizzle of infused oil for easy, even dosing across the whole tray.
ingredients: Salsa, sour cream, guacamole, to serve
steps: Layer chips, cheese, beans, and jalapeños on a baking sheet and bake until the cheese is melted, as usual.
Remove from the oven and drizzle the infused oil evenly over the top (or stir infused butter into warmed queso before pouring over).
Add remaining toppings and serve immediately while still warm.
dosing: Divide the infused oil or butter's total THC by the number of servings.

title: Cannabis-Infused Quesadillas
desc: Cheesy quesadillas brushed with infused oil right after cooking.
steps: Cook the quesadilla in a dry pan with a little regular oil until the cheese melts and both sides are golden and crisp.
Remove from heat and brush one side lightly with the infused oil while still hot.
Let rest 1-2 minutes so the oil absorbs, then slice and serve.
dosing: Divide the infused oil's total THC by the number of wedges.

title: Cannabis-Infused Jalapeño Poppers
desc: Cream cheese-stuffed poppers finished with a drizzle of infused oil right out of the oven.
steps: Mix cream cheese and cheddar, then fill each jalapeño half. Top with bacon if using.
Bake at 400°F for about 20 minutes, until the cheese is melted and jalapeños are tender.
Remove from the oven and drizzle the warm infused oil evenly over the poppers.
Let sit 2 minutes before serving.
dosing: Divide the infused oil's total THC by the number of poppers.
